title: Brauer pullback to the reduction of a curve
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a separated finite-type scheme of dimension at most one (a curve [def-sc-curves], without the algebraic-closedness restriction). Let $i:C_{\mathrm{red}}\to C$ be its reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. The canonical pullback
$$H^2(C_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,C})\longrightarrow H^2((C_{\mathrm{red}})_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,C_{\mathrm{red}}})$$
is injective. Here cohomology is [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and the groups are cohomological Brauer groups [def-br]. The map is the cohomology pullback to $i^*\mathbf G_{m,C}$ followed by the map induced by $i^*\mathbf G_{m,C}\to\mathbf G_{m,C_{\mathrm{red}}}$. Neither smoothness, properness nor reducedness of $C$ is assumed.

proof.text: Finite type over a field makes C Noetherian. On a finite affine cover the nilradical is finitely generated, hence nilpotent: choose nilpotence exponents of its finitely many generators; any product of sufficiently many generators contains one to its vanishing power. Take the maximum bound over the finite cover. Thus its coherent nilradical N satisfies N^m=0 globally. For an etale V over C, flatness pulls N back to the ideal of V times_C C_red; this is reduced because it is etale over reduced C_red, so it equals V_red. On affine etale objects the quotient map on rings is surjective and units lift modulo this nilpotent ideal. Hence 1 → 1+N_et → G_m,C → i_*G_m,C_red → 1 is exact.

For j≥1 the formula 1+a ↦ a induces (1+N^j)/(1+N^(j+1)) ≅ (N^j/N^(j+1))_et. The cross term ab lies in N^(2j)⊆N^(j+1). Flat pullback to an affine etale object preserves the exact sequence of the ideals, so the formula is surjective there and has the indicated kernel; sheafification preserves these identities.

Every quasi-coherent etale sheaf has vanishing H^q for q≥2 on C. Choose a finite affine cover; separatedness makes its finite intersections affine. Affine etale vanishing and the Cech spectral sequence identify its etale cohomology with the Cech groups of this cover. Affine Zariski vanishing and the same spectral sequence identify those groups with Zariski cohomology. Noetherian cohomology vanishes above dimension, and dim C≤1.

Descend in j starting with N^m=0. The long exact sequence of each filtration step and the preceding H^2 vanishing imply H^2(C,1+N^j)=0. The long exact sequence of the units sequence then makes H^2(C,G_m) → H^2(C,i_*G_m,C_red) injective. Closed immersions are finite; exact finite pushforward identifies the target with H^2(C_red,G_m). Naturality of the edge map and the adjunction defining the units pullback identify this composite with the canonical map in the statement.
